item.title: Amid Iran war, President Trump suggests short-term oil price spike is 'small price to pay' for peace
item.description: As American drivers face spiking prices at the pump, President Donald Trump asserted that increased oil prices are a "small price to pay" to achieve peace.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg and Google's Brin close on massive Miami estates worth over $220M combined
item.description: Four of the world's richest men now own Miami estates within 20 miles as tech power shifts from Silicon Valley to Florida's billionaire enclaves.

item.title: Ford recalls 1.74 million vehicles due to rearview camera blackouts, issues
item.description: Ford is recalling 1.74 million vehicles over software issues causing rearview display failures. Bronco, Edge, Escape owners affected by display problems.

item.title: GE Aerospace pours $1B into US manufacturing as CEO touts ‘tremendous demand’
item.description: GE Aerospace announces massive $1 billion U.S. investment, plans to hire 5,000 workers in 2026 as company races to meet tremendous aviation demand.

item.title: IRS unveils proposed regulations for new Trump Accounts savings program
item.description: The IRS and Treasury proposed new rules for Trump Accounts, including details for opening an account and taking the federal seed money if eligible to do so.

item.title: Will tapping oil reserves curb soaring gas prices?
item.description: G7 finance ministers weigh emergency oil reserve release as Middle East tensions send crude soaring above $115, threatening global economic stability.

item.title: Fed officials closely monitor Iran conflict for potential inflation impact
item.description: Hostilities with Iran pose a potential risk for higher inflation as Federal Reserve policymakers monitor the energy price impact ahead of their next meeting to discuss rate cuts.

item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Hormuz will not stop history
item.description: President Trump is bending the arc of history toward freedom and prosperity

item.title: Budget deficit hits $1 trillion in first five months of fiscal year: CBO
item.description: Federal budget deficit reached $1 trillion in five months through February 2026 as tax revenue jumped $206 billion due to higher income tax and tariff collections, CBO data shows.

item.title: Clams, raw oysters recalled over possible norovirus contamination across 9 states: FDA
item.description: The FDA said a recall was issued for clams and oysters distributed in nine states over possible norovirus contamination, a contagious infection commonly known as the stomach flu.
